answer.text: Individual company fundamentals first, irrespective of sector/economy

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Bottom-up = start with company, judge independently. Top-down = start with macro/sector. **The Trap:** Both have merit; PMs often blend. **Cross-Exam Context:** Topic 18. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Peter Lynch was a famous bottom-up investor; Buffett too. Bottom-up works well in less-crowded markets.
